32553Ozymandias

Ozymandias may refer to:

- [Ozymandias](https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Ozymandias_%28Shelley%29), a poem by Percy Bysshe Shelley.
- [Ozymandias](https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Ozymandias_%28Smith%29), a poem by Horace Smith.
